name: agent-scaffold
description: Interview-driven CLI (and soon a web app) that generates a project's Claude Code setup: CLAUDE.md, settings, MCP, rules, skills, subagents and hooks.
frameworks: Typer, questionary, Jinja2, pytest; uv for packaging
architecture: models.py holds the Answers dataclass and the catalogs (stacks, MCP servers, agents). generate.py is a pure function Answers -> list[GeneratedFile] that renders Jinja2 templates in templates/. writer.py plans and applies changes to disk (create / merge / skip / overwrite). cli.py runs the questionary interview and the Typer command. The planned FastAPI service and Next.js wizard reuse generate.py unchanged.
